name: Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Limited
summary: Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Limited manufactures and sells pharmaceutical products and active pharmaceutical ingredients India and internationally. The company provides drugs, ayurvedic, nutraceuticals, food and dietary supplements, derma and cosmetics, healthcare and hospital products, over-the-counter (OTC) products, active pharmaceutical ingredients, excipients, and compounds.
